_source: Table 2 / Fig. 3 of Genser et al. (2023), Data in Brief 48, 109117. dist_m is measured from the stop line (upstream detectors) or from the junction exit (downstream detectors). 'loops' lists every physical loop the detector id covers (Table 2: D4-D8 detect MPT+bike (+PT) on all lanes of the approach/exit); 'w' = share of the field events injected on that loop, 'route'/'vtype' = what is injected. Entries marked INFERRED are not stated in the paper. Event classes for d6/d7 (tram vs MPT) are derived from the CSV, see 'classify'.

d1._data: 139 events/day, ALL followed by a d2 event within 150 s; occupancy 26-46 s (median 33 s); events only 07-22 h; 60% of d2 trams are preceded by a d1 event. => trams dwelling at a stop ~220 m upstream (one line). Hybrid: a real tram stops there for the observed time, then continues; the matching d2 event is then emergent.

d4._inferred: bike share ~2.5%: only 26/287 d8 events are not tram-linked (short 2-5 s events = bikes/MPT on the S arm), so at most ~25 N->S bikes/day pass d4.

d5._inferred: w split: d9 (E->W lane) ~2137/day of d5 ~3016/day => 71% E->W (sg4), 29% E->N (sg5)

d6._inferred: sg6 = MPT, sg11 = tram only. 98% of d6 occupancies end with sg11 green (18% sg6) => PT; an event is MPT when sg6, not sg11, is green at its end.

d7._inferred: Occupancy is ~28 s irrespective of the signal (tram dwelling at a stop on the S arm, like d1 on the N arm). 99.7% of d7 events are followed by a d6 event within 60 s, so d7 inherits the class of that d6 event (PT if sg11 releases it, MPT if sg6).

d8._note: Table 2: MPT+PT+bike. Data: 261/287 events are trams (20-50 s after d3); 26 short (2-5 s) events are non-tram. In hybrid mode the S_out loops are emergent too (validated, not forced).

d9._inferred: inner/left W_out lane (south side, E->W through): count ~2137/day ~ E->W flow

d10._inferred: outer/right W_out lane (north side, N->W right turn): count ~857/day ~ d4 car share
